info.title: Foundation data search
info.description: Read-only search over US grantmakers and their grants, compiled from public IRS Form 990-PF and Form 990 Schedule I e-file records. No warranty.

get.summary: Build date, row counts, subject tags, states, endpoints and caveats.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Set to text for compact plain text. Omit for JSON.

get.summary: Profile of one funder: assets, giving by year, application information, officers, subject mix, top recipients, latest grants. Where the funder's own website has been read, web_profile adds what the site says (takes requests or not, priorities, geography, eligibility, deadlines, how to apply) with the pages read and the date; it is null when the site has not been read.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Funder EIN (9 digits) or part of the funder name.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Two-letter state, only used to narrow a name search.

parameters.name: pick
parameters.description: For a name search: which match to show, 1 is the largest by assets.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Set to text for compact plain text. Omit for JSON.

get.summary: Who has funded one recipient organization, by funder and fiscal year.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Recipient EIN (9 digits), or part of the recipient name together with state.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Two-letter state. Required when q is a name.

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: Fiscal years, for example 2022-2025 or 2024.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of funders, default 40, at most 100.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Set to text for compact plain text. Omit for JSON.

get.summary: Funders ranked by the grants they made to recipients in one state that match the filters, with example grants.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Two-letter recipient state. Required.

parameters.name: county
parameters.description: Recipient county name or its beginning, for example Palm Beach.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma separated subject tags, for example aging_seniors,food_hunger. See /api/info for the list.

parameters.name: all_tags
parameters.description: Set to 1 to require every tag instead of any tag.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Words that must all appear in the grant purpose or recipient name.

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: Fiscal years, for example 2022-2025.

parameters.name: preselected
parameters.description: no keeps funders that accept requests (private foundations that do not check the preselected-only box, plus public charities); yes keeps preselected-only foundations.

parameters.name: min_grant
parameters.description: Smallest grant amount to count.

parameters.name: funder_type
parameters.description: pf for private foundations, pc for public charities.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Rank by dollars or by number of grants.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of funders, default 25, at most 100.

parameters.name: examples
parameters.description: Example grants per funder, 0 to 5, default 3.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Set to text for compact plain text. Omit for JSON.

get.summary: Funders that support several of the given recipient organizations.

parameters.name: eins
parameters.description: Comma separated recipient EINs, at most 12.

parameters.name: min_peers
parameters.description: Smallest number of the given organizations a funder must have funded, default 2.

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: Fiscal years, for example 2022-2025.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of funders, default 40, at most 100.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Set to text for compact plain text. Omit for JSON.
